## Exact claim or rule
Identify the current statement, state description, metadata field, or governance rule that needs correction.

## Current repository evidence
Cite the path/revision and distinguish current state, generated state, historical evidence, and archived external material.

## Proposed correction
Describe the bounded correction and the evidence supporting it.

## History and provenance
State what must remain immutable and whether a forward correction or reconciliation record is required.

## Dependent surfaces
List every human-readable or machine-readable surface that must remain synchronized.

## Review boundary
State explicit non-goals and the rollback path.
